# stb_image 1.18

The image loader that the game client links in. Author: Sean Barrett and contributors. Public domain (see the notice at the top of `stb_image.c`). Do not edit this file.

- Source: `cbits/stb_image.c` of the Haskell package `stb-image-0.2` (`https://hackage-content.haskell.org/package/stb-image-0.2/src/cbits/stb_image.c`). The official page (nothings.org) has only newer versions. The GitHub copy of Rich Geldreich (`richgel999/imageresampler`) has the same code. The two files differ only in white space at the end of lines.
- SHA-256 of `stb_image.c`: `5b8f85483337233ace2e70c1ca31aa874b5680d1bd4349487f62e610ef7925ab`.
- Version: 1.18 (2008-08-02). The client is version 1.18 or 1.19 (the last one only fixes a check of interlaced PNG files).

## Why this version

- 115 of the 128 names of group C1 are functions of this file. The other 13 are game functions (`createfont`, `loadfont`, `freadswap`) and helpers that the project named by hand (`stbi_get8`, `stbi_skip`).
- The client has no Softimage PIC loader. That loader came with version 1.20. The client also has no GIF loader and no input callbacks, which came later.
- The zlib code builds the length table in a local variable of the function (`z_codelength`). Version 1.17 keeps it in a static variable. The stack frame of `compute_huffman_codes` in the client is 0xa00 bytes, which fits a local table.
- The versions 1.33 and 1.35 of the GitHub repository `nothings/stb` do not have 20 of the 80 names of group C1, for example `stbi_register_loader`.

The client does not use this file yet. The functions of group C1 come from `src/lifted/client` and from `src/client/image`.
